changes: Koala init now generates .Codex/agents from the full .claude/agents prompt set. It removed the four-file Codex whitelist, added full drift verification, added entrypoint checks for representative mirrored prompts, removed stale Codex-only prompts, and clarified docs that hooks/settings/skills remain Claude-only.
usage: Run koala init in a project. Users should inspect .Codex/agents for mirrored prompt files and read .Codex/README.md for Codex-specific activity guidance. Continue using KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex koala session_brief or bin/koala-codex.js where available.
expectedOutcome: After koala init, the project tree shows .Codex/agents with the same Koala prompt names as .claude/agents, including koala-implementer and koala-review-quality. It does not show .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json.
actualTranscript: Fresh init transcript showed Codex agents count: 16; representative prompts included .Codex/agents/koala-implementer.md, .Codex/agents/koala-review-quality.md, .Codex/agents/koala-review-test-coverage.md, and .Codex/agents/test-intent.md. Codex hooks present: no. Codex settings present: no. Stale prompts present: no. .Codex/README.md says .Codex/agents is generated from the full .claude/agents prompt set and Claude hooks/settings/skills remain under .claude.
outcomeDiff: No mismatch found. Actual transcript matches the expected user-visible tree and documentation boundary.
limitations: Codex hooks/settings/skills are intentionally not generated because Codex does not consume Claude Code runtime hooks/settings/skills. This is a documented boundary, not missing support.
pitfalls: Koala evidence became stale after a later docs typo fix because HEAD changed; the fix was to rerun/refresh verification evidence before advancing TEST. Also .Codex/README.md had an old lowercase .codex/agents path that docs review caught and we fixed.
